description: Returns one error group in full: message, status, counts, first and last seen, environment, agent context, the top stack frames and the latest breadcrumbs. If the error came back after it was marked resolved, it also shows the note it was resolved with, so you can see what the last fix tried. For a resolved error it reports whether the fix held: events since, releases deployed since and whether the fixing commit is live.

errorId.description: The error ID to get details for

name: runheed_get_error
title: Get an error
